body: 为高中生设计横版细胞呼吸概念图。以细胞轮廓和放大的线粒体作为主体，区分细胞质中的糖酵解、线粒体基质中的后续反应及内膜上的电子传递过程。用不同色带表示物质流与能量流，标注葡萄糖、氧气、二氧化碳、水和 ATP。控制文字密度，中文术语清楚，配色一致，避免装饰遮挡流程。

en.title: Cellular respiration learning diagram
en.description: Legible Chinese concept diagram distinguishes cytoplasm, mitochondrial matrix and inner membrane, with oxygen, water and ATP
en.body:
## How to use

Use the exact recorded prompt. No reference image is required. Changes to the prompt or inputs create an untested variant.

## Observed result

Legible Chinese concept diagram distinguishes cytoplasm, mitochondrial matrix and inner membrane, with oxygen, water and ATP. Simplified: omits the acetyl-CoA transition and detailed chemiosmosis; not a complete biochemistry teaching reference.

## Source and generation

The source provides an original prompt; this production uses the separately recorded working prompt. [Source](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#create-scientific-and-educational-visuals). Source-post engagement does not measure this newly generated example.

Produced with the built-in GPT Image tool. The tool did not return an exact provider model ID; GPT Image 2.6 is the research topic, not a verified version claim for this output. All reference images used here were generated for this project.

使用本次实际提交的提示词，无需参考图。修改提示词或底图后属于未验证的新变体。

中文概念图区分细胞质、线粒体基质与内膜，标出氧气、水和 ATP。图中省略乙酰辅酶 A 转换及化学渗透细节，不应作为完整的生化教学图。
